verdict.rationale: Letta has several isolation mechanisms that approximate safe testing. The web app runs agents in a managed cloud sandbox. Headless `--ephemeral` runs a one-shot task without creating or persisting an agent, memory blocks or MemFS. `/fork` branches a conversation without changing the original thread. Local mode keeps all state on-device. However, none of this is documented as a dedicated test/staging environment separate from production agents and data. missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or staging environment (e.g. separate test projects or keys) isolated from production, documented guidance on testing without affecting production agents and memory, independent or hands-on corroboration.
